title: Recursive branching process
statement: Let $A,B,\mathrm{Kont}$ be predicates on natural numbers. For zero rounds, the process at position $t$ and count $c$ holds exactly when $\mathrm{Kont}(c)$ holds. For $r+1$ rounds, it holds when either $A(t)$ holds and the process continues for $r$ rounds at position $t+1$ with count $c+1$, or $B(t)$ holds and it continues at position $t+1$ with count $c$.
hypotheses_covered: round count and position $t$ and count $c$ are natural numbers
